scope: All service pages assessed in both languages using the recorded reading and shared-component review, with final rendered evidence. This is implementation evidence, not independent professional certification or search-engine performance.

sources.finding: Investor registration replaces the former foreign-investment licensing model; activity approvals remain distinct.
Insurance complaints transferred from SAMA to Insurance Authority.
Syrian copyright source is Decree 62/2013, not the replaced 2001 reference.
Investment instructions concern Law 18/2021 as amended in 2023 and 2025.
Official archive of Syrian cybercrime Law 20/2022; applicability still requires amendment and event-date checking.
Dubai rental adjudication belongs to RDC within its jurisdiction; distinguish RERA regulatory functions.
Current official regulator branding is UAE Capital Market Authority.
